$comment: Two cells on the same CP-heavy grid + seeds:
hebbian_on : enable_hebbian_formation=True  (refines holon membership from observed correlations)
hebbian_off: enable_hebbian_formation=False (static lex-chunked partition stays for the whole run)
Simulation runs 30 s with hebbian_warmup_s=4 so the recluster has ~26 s of post-warmup ticks.
events.hebbian_recluster           - real membership-drift events (should be >0 only on hebbian_on)
events.hebbian_recluster_attempted - fires but didn't drift (debug counter)
events.holon_admm_result           - downstream effect on ADMM activity
outcomes.restoration.pwsf_post     - downstream effect on restoration quality
outcomes.time_to_stabilise_s        - downstream effect on convergence speed
name: hebbian_eval
